record.title: Acquire the frozen current-policy RF-chain survey
record.intent: Observe frequency-dependent sampled response without changing instrument software policy.
requirements: Execute docs/research/rf-current-survey-protocol.md under the three-hour operator authorization. Preserve physical wiring, source and scope firmware, calibration and entitlements; use factory USB point commands and documented ordinary scope settings only.

Revalidate USB ancestry/ownership, isolated lease/route and scope acquisition settings under a fresh complete capture. Retain every serial intent/result and raw SCPI request/response; require graceful capture exit and drop statistics.

Use the fixed twelve-visit frequency sequence and raw power code 0, with five fresh 100k RAW ASCII records per visit at reported 4 GSa/s and fixed 50mV/div. Require RUN/settling/STOP for each record and full metadata/count/range qualification.

Stop on recorder/transport, source-command uncertainty, unexpected network/state, frequency qualification, invalid record or range failure. Preserve a partial survey and all rejected/censored points; no automatic command/export retries or new points.

Restore original scope/export settings and running acquisition where communication remains healthy. Final source command is the declared 100MHz return anchor; no silent additional serial cleanup or policy transition.
Seal and verify all raw data before offline reduction. Commit and push the acquisition conclusion before any successor experiment.
acceptance: The frozen 60-record survey or its exact bounded failure has retained evidence
